svg.title: Wireframe 06: Results
svg.desc: Results screen for a three-machine line run. A headline card that says why (the first finding), then the plain-language findings, key numbers with their likely range, charts per run kind each with a data table (bars with their likely ranges and the value over time for a process run; insets for a search run, with the best-so-far chart and the table of all trials, and for an optimization model, with the decisions, the goal and the fully used limits), the replications table, export to CSV, PDF and project zip, the Tell us what you built link, and the footer with model name, run id, fidelity label, replications and confidence, engine name and version, and the sentence: Simulation results are estimates and carry no warranty.
svg.text: weld is the bottleneck: busy 90% of the time, with an average wait of 15.7 min.
weld is the bottleneck: busy 90% of the time, with an average wait of 15.7 min.
The estimates for weld.wait.mean are still uncertain: weld.wait.mean is 15.7 min plus or minus 2.09 min. About 60 replications ...
Display units are the interface's; summary.json and the tables stay in SI units.
Busy share by station, with the likely range
Over time: weld.queue_length, average of the repeat runs
Every repeat run's value of every metric; Export CSV for replications or timeseries
A search run: best so far, then all trials
Filled: meets every limit. Hollow: breaks one.
An optimization model: the best plan
Each chart has a table beside it.
Values from spec 2's product mix; the trials are example data.
Tell us what you built (opens your browser)
